Fix one finding on change 278 (PR 480, branch `feat/factory-own-props`, trail 405). `git fetch origin`; start from `origin/feat/factory-own-props` (762a42ed); local branch `fix/factory-generics-local`; commit locally; I push. Read /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/worker-contract.md, then `entire trail finding show 01M7H1ZB9PWK --branch feat/factory-own-props --repo gh/orin-dx/caliper --project gh/orin-dx` and crates/core/src/extractor/factory_props.rs ~74-76, resolver/mod.rs ~997-1006, resolver/chain.rs ~152, resolver/callee.rs ~86. The finding: type parameters of the render callback (`(props: {value: Base}) =>
`) are added to scope while resolving the factory's RESULT, so a module-level `Base` in the result type (`declare function make

(tag: P, render: unknown): React.FC`) is treated as a placeholder, callee.rs returns None, and the component is discarded. Fix: callback generics are in scope ONLY while resolving the callback's own props type (the factory_props resolution branch); the factory result resolves with its own scope only. Test first (fails on base): the exact example `interface Base { label: string }; declare function make

(tag: P, render: unknown): React.FC; const Widget = make('div', (props: { value: Base }) =>

)` keeps Widget with its props; also: a callback generic that really is used in the callback's props (`(props: { v: T })`) stays a placeholder there; chakra('div', {variants}) shapes unchanged. No generator or red-team. Gates (targeted): `pnpm install --offline --ignore-scripts --frozen-lockfile` in the worktree first; `just lint doc-check machete typos`; nextest `-p caliper-docgen-core`. Then `/code-review low` once and AWAIT its output; fix only real bugs. Own CARGO_TARGET_DIR under /Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/, rust 1.99.1 first on PATH (/Users/gabe/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.1-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin). Cap 40 tool calls.
